title: A solid is rigid and keeps its own shape
summary: A solid is rigid, keeps a definite shape, and has a volume that barely changes when it is squeezed.
body: OpenStax Chemistry says a solid is rigid and possesses a definite shape. Both liquid and solid samples, the page says, have volumes that are very nearly independent of pressure. A solid therefore does not flow into a new shape the way a liquid does, and it does not swell to fill a room the way a gas does. Flowers, Robinson, Langley, and Theopold, published 11 March 2015. The page is a textbook classification, not a catalogue of materials.
